page.layout: Printed page number at top right. Title block across the full width at top, with an ornament above it. Below the title, one column of text, with marginal notes in the left margin (one above the first paragraph) and in the right margin, beside the text. No running head and no catchword.

main_text.head: FRAGMENTA LEGVM XII. TABVLARVM AD PANDECTARVM & Codicis seriem adcommodata.
LIBER SECVNDVS.
De legibus.
TIT. I.
main_text.p: Iura non in singulas personas sed generaliter constituì 1. l.8.de legibus.

PRIVILEGIA[?] ne irrogan-{e}to hæc Cicero 3. de legibus & pro Sestio. Cur, cùm XII. Tabulis sancitum esset, ut neque privile-gium irrogari liceret, nulla vox est audita Consulum. de hac lege dixi in superiore legum tractatu.

Interrex Fabius aiebat in XII. Tabulis legem esse, ut quodcunque postremum{b} populus iussisset id ius ratumque esset. hæc Livius 7. & 9: Cicero pro Balbo: & 2. de inventione. l.16.l.17.l.28.ff.de legib.
main_text.head: De Statu hominum.
TIT. II.
main_text.p: Decemuiri in X, mense gigni hominem non in undecimo{c}. hæc Gellius 3.c.6. Dixi ad Nanellam de restitutionibus & ea quæ parit XI. mens. sc.[?] 59.
Deinde cùm esset citò legatus, tanquàm

page.notes: The page number 95 is printed at top right. The ornament and title are printed in large spaced capitals. Marks in the text: a superscript after PRIVILEGIA is uncertain, read as a note mark [?]. The right-margin note beside the Decemuiri paragraph is partly uncertain: "Nanellam" and "sc. 59" are doubtful. The left-margin note "1." is printed above the first paragraph and is placed as a note there. The right-margin "b" note appears beside the Interrex paragraph and is reproduced as printed. The text ends mid-sentence at the bottom, with no catchword.
